rationale.conceptual: The method is an established but non-trivial computational chemistry workflow (plane-wave DFT + CI-NEB) requiring proper system setup, pseudopotential selection, convergence, and interpretation. It is not a novel algorithm but demands substantial domain understanding to reproduce reliably.
rationale.execution: The workflow spans three DFT stages: model relaxation, NEB barrier calculation, and four additional metal-site formation energies. It involves installing Quantum ESPRESSO, managing pseudopotentials, writing input files, running jobs, and parsing outputs. This is a moderate pipeline with interdependent steps and typical HPC tooling challenges.

The pipeline consists of three sequential DFT stages with dependency on preceding relaxations, fitting a multi-stage engineering effort. No large data or GPU needed.
